page.overview:
Who is Dr. Ellie Sattler?

Dr. Ellie Sattler (formerly Degler) is a paleobotanist and the deuteragonist of Jurassic Park, a minor supporting character in Jurassic Park III, one of the three unseen overarching protagonists of Jurassic World and one of the 6 main protagonists (alongside Alan Grant, Owen Grady, Ian Malcolm, Claire Dearing, and Kayla Watts) of Jurassic World: Dominion. During the events of the first book and first film, she was invited by John Hammond to Jurassic Park. She appeared in , where she's married to Mark Degler and has two children from him, Charlie Degler and another unnamed baby sibling. Over 20 years later, she reappeared in where she teams up with Alan Grant and Ian Malcolm to investigate the giant locust infestation. Having gotten divorced from Mark at some point, Ellie resumes her romantic relationship with Alan.

Ellie Sattler was born in the United States on a date that is currently inexact, although the Jurassic Park script states that; she was in her mid-twenties in June 1993; which would indicate that; her birth took place in the mid-1960s.

Ellie had earned a doctorate in science from a currently unknown institution in the 1990's and had pursued a career in paleobotany, the study of ancient plants through their fossil remains; such as pollen, leaf impressions and petrified wood. Her expertise; included both extant and fossil plant taxa, and she had occasionally engaged in research on other aspects of prehistoric ecosystems in addition to paleobotanical studies. In her late twenties he became both professionally and romantically involved; with vertebrate paleontologist, Alan Grant, collaborating; with him on paleontological excavations; including a productive badlands site near Snakewater, Montana that; had held exceptionally preserved remains of deinonychosaurus dinosaurs; this particular expedition was funded; by International Genetic Technologies CEO, John Hammond. It appears that; Ellie was interested in having children in the future, an interest that; Grant; who had difficulty interacting; with children, did not share. At some point, they had adopted a blue and yellow macaw; which they had named Jack.

Ellie Sattler was Alan Grant's partner and girlfriend, and had worked; with him at the dig site in Montana. She had a Ph.D in . She was described in the script as:

Also known as: Ellie, Dr. Sattler.
